question: How should purification be performed after bringing the object from the middle of water?
premises: The object is brought from the middle of water.
Purification is to be carried out.
Cow products and similar substances are the means.
inference: After bringing it from the middle of water, one should perform purification with cow products and so forth.
plain_english: Having brought it from the middle of the water, one should perform purification with cow products and so forth.
